base_source.title: M.P. Bhumi Vikas Rules, 2012 — consolidated text up to 6 March 2025
base_source.authority: Directorate of Town and Country Planning, Madhya Pradesh
base_source.tls_warning: The official departmental host (mptownplan.gov.in) presents an SSL certificate for *.test.mp.gov.in by an untrusted CA, causing browser ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID. NiyamSetu serves the identical verified official document locally at /api/pdf while preserving links to the official server.
base_source.note: Official departmental publication discovered, but it does not establish completeness of amendments after 6 March 2025. The sample data included with this app is excerpted from the event-provided dataset, not a complete rulebook.

amendment_watchlist.note: Secondary source reports an amendment concerning construction/reconstruction on plots up to 500 sq m. Primary notification and effective date have not been verified in this project. Do not state a definitive permission exemption based on this report.

amendment_watchlist.effective_date: 2025-12-15 (date in secondary report; verify against primary publication)
amendment_watchlist.note: A secondary copy/search result describes a gazette item concerning green building provisions. Primary-host verification not completed.

dataset_scope_note: The bundled demo excerpts are copied from the event-provided sample JSONL. They are not a full rulebook and are not independently checked against every PDF glyph/cell.

official_listing_review.finding: The department listing exposes planning instruments and amendments; that alone does not establish a complete amendment history for the Bhumi Vikas Rules or verify the reported Rule 2(5)(c) notification. Do not conflate amendments to a different instrument with amendments to the Bhumi Vikas Rules.
